# Graph-Guided Hallucination Mitigation and Factual Consistency Verification

> Ground-truth subgraph path verification, counterfactual edge pruning, and bidirectional entailment checking to eliminate factual hallucinations.

## Core Findings

- Verifying generated statements against a verified reference knowledge graph via subgraph path matching detects hallucinated entity relations with higher precision than text-only semantic similarity models. [Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.14334]
- Counterfactual edge pruning removes unsupported relational hops from candidate generation contexts, increasing RAGAS faithfulness scores from 0.78 to > 0.85 on complex factual QA benchmarks. [Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.15217]
- Bidirectional entailment checking between extracted response triples and retrieved context subgraphs provides verifiable token-level citation attribution without post-hoc manual labeling. [Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.13252]
